title: Ensure 'Domain member: Digitally encrypt or sign secure channel data (always)' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Domain member: Digitally encrypt or sign secure channel data (always) to 'Enabled'
reason: This policy prevents the server from establishing a secure channel with a domain controller unless the traffic is signed or encrypted, mitigating Man-in-the-Middle attacks.

title: Ensure 'Domain member: Digitally encrypt secure channel data (when possible)' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Domain member: Digitally encrypt secure channel data (when possible) to 'Enabled'
reason: When enabled, this policy requests encryption for all secure channel traffic, protecting sensitive authentication data from being intercepted in clear text.

title: Ensure 'Domain member: Digitally sign secure channel data (when possible)' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Domain member: Digitally sign secure channel data (when possible) to 'Enabled'
reason: This configuration attempts to sign all secure channel data to ensure the integrity of the data being transmitted to and from the domain controller.
